title: Q3 – Top-K Retrieval
description: It's time to find the needle in the haystack. In this quest, you will use a query vector to find the most relevant fragments in the Archive.
objective_text: Find the top 2 most semantically similar fragments to the vector [0.1, 0.1, 0.9].

verification.query: SELECT fragment_id FROM historical_fragments ORDER BY embedding <=> '[0.1, 0.1, 0.9]'::vector LIMIT 2;
